entities.summary: Raphael Sobiehrd-Mnishovsky of Sebuzin and of Horstein was a Bohemian lawyer and writer. He held various secretarial, diplomatic, and judicial posts under Rudolf II, Mathias, Ferdinand II, and Ferdinand III, under whom Raphael was the attorney-general.
